question: Tulika Maan is related to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Judo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tulika Maan** is an accomplished Indian judoka who competes in international Judo tournaments.
 
• She has represented India in several prestigious competitions and has gained recognition for her consistent performance in the sport of **Judo**.
 
• Judo, which originated in Japan, is a martial art and combat sport where opponents try to throw or take down their opponent to the ground.
 
• Tulika Maan achieved significant success in the **Commonwealth Games 2022**, where she won a **silver medal** in the women's 78 kg category.
 
• Her performance has brought attention to Judo in India and has inspired many young athletes to pursue this sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Judo as a Sport:**

 
 
• Judo was founded by **Jigoro Kano** in Japan in 1882 as a modern martial art derived from jujutsu.
 
• It is practiced worldwide and became an Olympic sport in **1964**.
 
• The objective is to score points through techniques like throws, holds, and submissions.
 
• The sport emphasizes discipline, respect, and physical fitness, making it a popular choice for individuals of all ages.
 
 
 
• **Tulika Maan’s Achievements:**
 
 
• She has participated in various international events, including the **Asian Judo Championships** and the **Commonwealth Games**.
 
• Her silver medal at the **2022 Commonwealth Games** was a remarkable achievement that showcased her talent and dedication.
 
• She is among the growing pool of Indian judokas bringing recognition to the sport.
 
 
 
• **Other Popular Sports in India:**
 
 
• **Athletics:** Includes track and field events like sprints, long-distance running, and javelin throw. Athletes like **Neeraj Chopra** have brought fame to India by winning international medals.
 
• **Weightlifting:** India has seen success in weightlifting events at the Commonwealth Games, with athletes like **Mirabai Chanu** earning accolades.
 
• **Badminton:** A highly popular sport in India, with stars like **P.V. Sindhu** and **Kidambi Srikanth** making the country proud on global platforms.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government Initiatives for Judo in India:**

 
 
• The **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** provides training facilities, coaching, and funding to support athletes in Judo.
 
• Judo is also a part of the **Khelo India** program, which aims to develop sports talent at the grassroots level.
 
• Indian judokas receive support for participating in international events through programs like the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**.
 
 
 
• **Notable Indian Judokas:**
 
 
• **Avtar Singh:** Represented India in the **2016 Rio Olympics**.
 
• **Shushila Likmabam:** Won a **silver medal** in Judo at the **2022 Commonwealth Games**.
 
• **Garima Chaudhary:** Competed in the **2012 London Olympics**.
